title: Parking: a turn end counts running work from Claude Code's own list, and a question mark brings the terminal back
summary: A turn end now counts running work from the Stop payload's background_tasks and session_crons lists, so a parked terminal stays parked while that work runs, and a closing question unparks it; malformed payloads fall back to the transcript count.

deferred.what: A closing question wrapped in or followed by markdown (for example **Shall I merge it?** or a question followed by a numbered list) does not end with ?, so with a listed task still running the terminal stays parked and green while the agent waits for the person
deferred.why: The literal ends-with-? rule was decided with the maintainer on issue #478 (unpark audit); widening it is a product call
